bell_shard.name: Bell Shard
bell_shard.desc: A sliver of the first bell. Begin each night one draft ahead.
bell_shard.hint: Keep the Wake-Lights in Hollowmere Village

wisp_jar.name: Wisp in a Jar
wisp_jar.desc: Every half minute, the wisp gathers every gem on the field.
wisp_jar.hint: Cut the Tolling Man down in the Wailing Forest

briar_crown.name: Briar Crown
briar_crown.desc: Whatever gnaws you is gnawed back (3 damage to attackers).
briar_crown.hint: Hold the Nave at Castle Vane

kings_coin.name: King's Coin
kings_coin.desc: The dead king's face still buys respect. WARES cost 15% less.
kings_coin.hint: A rite kept in the testing night

ledger_page.name: Sexton's Ledger-Page
ledger_page.desc: The first reroll of every night is free.
ledger_page.hint: Light Six for the Echo (The Bell's Echo)

ferrymans_coin.name: Ferryman's Coin
ferrymans_coin.desc: If the night takes you, the ferryman pays your gold out double.

pilgrims_flask.name: Pilgrim's Flask
pilgrims_flask.desc: One desperate swallow: rise once at a quarter of your life.
pilgrims_flask.hint: Find the Lights in the Mist (The Deep Mist)

hourless_glass.name: Hourless Glass
hourless_glass.desc: The night passes a tenth faster. Dawn comes sooner — so does the bell.
hourless_glass.hint: Hold the Cold Ground (The Cold Court)
